title: Cashless Bail Reporting Act

items.snippet: This bill requires the Department of Justice to publish annually a list of state and local governments that permit individuals who are charged with…

This bill requires the Department of Justice to publish annually a list of state and local governments that permit individuals who are charged with certain criminal offenses that pose a clear threat to public…

…Donald Trump issued an executive order that required the Department of Justice to submit to the Assistant to the President for Homeland Security a list of state and local jurisdictions that have substantially eliminated cash bail…
